## Pre-merge checklist

- [ ] `npm run ci` passes (typecheck + lint + format + test)
- [ ] No `any` types introduced
- [ ] No `console.log` left in `src/`
- [ ] Module boundary rules respected (see CONTRIBUTING.md §2)
- [ ] New env variables added to `.env.example` with documentation
- [ ] Database changes have a numbered migration file in `migrations/`
- [ ] Dictionary changes validated against `schemas/`
- [ ] Public API changes documented in `README.md` or `CONTRIBUTING.md`
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits format
